title: Readiness Estimator: Alternate Reality Games 2.0
definition: Estimates Alternate Reality Games 2.0 readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Alternate Reality Games 2.0 components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a game hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Alternate Reality Games 2.0 Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Alternate Reality Games 2.0 operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Alternate Reality Games 2.0 installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 78232 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where puppet masters monitoring, game logistics redundancy, or rabbit holes maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Alternate Reality Games 2.0 Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Alternate Reality Games 2.0: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Alternate Reality Games 2.0 — next-gen games blurring reality.

Phase 1 — Prove (puppet masters): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (game logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (rabbit holes): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (player safety): game hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and players-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
